candidates.angle: विशुद्धात्मा, pure inner being, shows the mind must be clear before action is untainted
सर्वभूतात्मभूतात्मा, whose self has become the self of all beings, reveals the root of unstained action
candidates.evidence: सर्वभूतात्मभूतात्मा (whose self has become the self of all beings)

candidates.angle: जितेन्द्रियः, senses conquered, marks the inner mastery that lets a yogi act without stain

en.intro: Krishna asks Arjuna to listen for one Sanskrit word that shows exactly where the stain on action comes from.
en.notice: The word is visuddhatma, pure inner being. A person acts without being stained not because the work is light, but because the inner being itself has been made pure, so no action can stick to it.
en.next: Krishna then shows that even while doing all this, the knower of reality should think, 'I do nothing at all.'
en.meaning: A disciplined yogi, pure in mind, self-mastered, and senses conquered, sees the same self in all beings and is not tainted by action while acting.

hi.intro: कृष्ण अर्जुन से एक संस्कृत शब्द सुनने को कहते हैं जो बताता है कि कर्म का दाग कहाँ से आता है।
hi.meaning: जिसकी इन्द्रियाँ अपने वशमें हैं, जिसका अन्तःकरण निर्मल है, जिसका शरीर अपने वशमें है और सम्पूर्ण प्राणियोंकी आत्मा ही जिसकी आत्मा है, ऐसा कर्मयोगी कर्म करते हुए भी लिप्त नहीं होता।
hi.next: कृष्ण फिर बताते हैं कि यह जानने वाला व्यक्ति, सब कुछ करते हुए भी सोचे कि, 'मैं तो कुछ नहीं करता।

en.intro: Krishna asks Arjuna to listen for one Sanskrit word that shows exactly where the stain on action comes from.
en.body: A disciplined yogi, pure in mind, self-mastered, and senses conquered, sees the same self in all beings and is not tainted by action while acting. The word is visuddhatma, pure inner being. A person acts without being stained not because the work is light, but because the inner being itself has been made pure, so no action can stick to it. Krishna then shows that even while doing all this, the knower of reality should think, 'I do nothing at all.'

issues: meaning_changed: "कर्म का दाग इसलिए नहीं लगता क्योंकि काम हल्का है, बल्कि इसलिए लगता है क्योंकि अन्तःकरण निर्मल होता है, जिससे कोई भी कर्म उस पर चिपकता नहीं है।" (The Hindi notice completely reverses the logic of the verse. The source states that the stain does not stick BECAUSE the inner being is pure (विशुद्धात्मा), but the notice claims the stain does not stick because the work is light and then contradicts itself by saying the stain does not stick because the inner being is pure. The 'because' (क्योंकि) clause is inverted and nonsensical.)

meaning_changed: "कर्म का दाग इसलिए नहीं लगता क्योंकि काम हल्का है" (The source states the yogi is not tainted because they see the same self in all beings (सर्वभूतात्मभूतात्मा) and have a pure inner being (विशुद्धात्मा). The script incorrectly introduces the idea that the action itself is 'light' (काम हल्का है) as the reason for not being stained, which contradicts the source.)

meaning_changed: "कर्म का दाग इसलिए नहीं लगता क्योंकि काम हल्का है, बल्कि इसलिए नहीं लगता क्योंकि अन्तःकरण निर्मल होता है" (The Hindi notice introduces the idea that 'action is light' (काम हल्का है) as a reason for not being stained, which contradicts the source meaning. The source states the yogi is not tainted because their inner being is pure and they see the same self in all beings, not because the action is light. It also uses 'बल्कि' (rather than/not X but Y), which is a contrast template.)
